name: tv series suggestions
description: A viewer asks for TV series suggestions in three natural phrasings: a weekend plan question, an imperative request, and a bare suggestions question. Verifies the dedicated movies_tv_series fact answers with a mixed list of beloved and underground shows across genres.

turns.text: What series should I watch this weekend?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: "what series should I watch" matches the movies_tv_series keywords and returns the numbered series list. Turn 2: the imperative "recommend a good series" still routes to knowledge and returns the same curated list. Turn 3: "TV series suggestions" matches the dedicated series keywords.
expected.behavior: The dedicated movies_tv_series fact (added alongside the genre facts) wins over the generic movies_recommendations fact because its series-specific keywords score higher for series requests. Replies come as numbered lists, which the list-trimming helper can cut on request.
